thread:
Asha (Finance): Heads-up: Customer 'AcmeAI' got a chargeback on their invoice for 2,400 GPU hours last month but they claim they had a credit allocation. Recon shows the credits were applied to the wrong billing account (internal-research), not the customer's dedicated project. Can ops check recent SKU mappings with our reseller?
Priia (Finance): typo alert — Priya here. I pulled the invoice and the line item is 'nvidia-t4-preemptible' but vendor changed SKU naming on 2026-02-28. We have a mapping table in billing-lambda but it wasn't updated.
Marco (Cloud Ops): digging. I see a feed from the reseller that updated product_sku to 'compute.gpu.t4.preempt' and billing-lambda's SKU -> account map matched on exact string; so anything older/newer that didn't match fell back to default_account = internal-research.
Ben (Sales Ops): Acme says they had a contract credit applied in Feb; they were told by AM that cloud credits would auto-apply. This is bad for renewals.
Jordan (CS): I'm on the call with Acme tomorrow. Need a clear remediation and timeline for returning credits.
billing-bot: :information_source: Alert: billing-lambda job failed to map 18 invoice lines to customer accounts on 2026-03-10T04:12:09Z (job id bl-20260310-07).
Priya (Finance): Proposed fix: 1) update SKU mapping table to use regex matching and include vendor SKU aliases, 2) re-run billing-lambda for Feb/Mar to reassign credits, 3) create a conservative reconciliation report to show before/after for Acme.
Marco (Cloud Ops): I'll open OP-3321 to add regex rules and a nightly audit that flags fallback-account assignments. Will also add a dry-run mode for re-attribution.
Asha (Finance): Priority: Acme gets a provisional credit today and we finalize after re-attribution. We should avoid altering customer-facing invoices until we confirm. Priya, prepare the provisional credit note.
Priya (Finance): Will do. Also running a quick BigQuery to list affected lines:
```
SELECT invoice_id, line_item_description, product_sku, cost, account_assigned
FROM `company_billing.gcp_export.invoice_lines_*`
WHERE DATE(invoice_date) BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-03-15'
  AND account_assigned = 'internal-research'
  AND LOWER(product_sku) LIKE '%gpu%'
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Marco (Cloud Ops): ran a targeted check, got 42 lines that look like customer credits. Saved CSV to gs://redwood-billing/recon/2026-03-11/acme-suspects.csv
Ben (Sales Ops): Can we tag which ones map to Acme? I have their project ids: acme-prod-01, acme-experiments.
Marco (Cloud Ops): adding project_id join and will re-run. Also the reseller sent an email with the SKU alias list — attaching to OP-3321.
Asha (Finance): Who will own the re-attribution run? We need an auditable diff and a rollback plan.
Marco (Cloud Ops): I'll own the run but will do in dry-run first. Merge plan: run reassigner with --dry-run -> generate CSV of proposed reassignments -> Priya validates -> then run real job and produce final report.
Priya (Finance): Sounds good. I'll create a validation checklist (confidence thresholds, manual review flags for cost > $5k, and an approvals column).
Jordan (CS): Please mark the lines that impacted Acme so I can include them in the customer update.
billing-bot: :warning: Budget policy: if reassigner moves > $10k of charges between accounts in a single run, auto-create a finance incident ticket.
Marco (Cloud Ops): noted. The dry-run shows proposed reassignments totaling $28,700 across 12 lines, $9,200 of which map to Acme.
Asha (Finance): Ok proceed with dry-run and upload the CSV to INFRA-3321. Set review deadline EOD today. If confidence high, we will issue provisional credit then finalize after real run.
Marco (Cloud Ops): dry-run CSV uploaded: INFRA-3321 -> /artifacts/dryrun-2026-03-11-acme.csv
Priya (Finance): Reviewing now. Two notes: 1) there are 3 lines lacking project metadata — will need to use job logs to attribute, 2) some credits were already consumed against future invoices — need to ensure we don't double-credit.
Ben (Sales Ops): If this impacts MRR recognition, finance please loop in revenue ops. Acme renewal is next quarter.
Asha (Finance): noted — revenue-ops@redwood oncc. Also add a temporary alert rule: any fallback_account assignment triggers an async Slack alert to #finance and #cloud-ops.
Marco (Cloud Ops): added rule, routed to #finance and pd-low. OP-3321 now updated with runbook and rollback steps.
Priya (Finance): final ask: update the billing-lambda PR to include unit tests for SKU alias handling and add a schema validation for account assignment field. I'll review the PR this afternoon.
Marco (Cloud Ops): PR #4892 opened. pinging @Priya for review.
Jordan (CS): Thanks team — I'll tell Acme we expect a provisional credit today and a confirmed update by EOD tomorrow.
Asha (Finance): Closing loop for now. Once the real run completes, post the final CSV here and we'll decide on invoice adjustments. :thumbsup:
